name: userorbit
description: Explore customer feedback, support, product insights and onboarding in Userorbit.

interface.longDescription:
Userorbit connects customer feedback, roadmaps, support, help content, onboarding and product insights in your workspace. Explore requests and customer context, prepare release notes and help content, and investigate product activity with the tools available to your connection.

With the appropriate permissions and your instruction, make supported changes to feedback, save unpublished content drafts, edit workflow drafts, or send support replies. Review action results and delivery status: a saved reply does not by itself prove delivery.

Available tools depend on permissions, OAuth grants and host support. Event subscriptions also require workspace enrollment. Event callbacks may be delivered more than once; callback acceptance alone does not prove that a follow-up completed. A Userorbit account and connected workspace are required.
defaultPrompt: What are customers asking for lately?
Show product activity for a selected project.

publication.release_notes: Expanded permission-aware customer, support, analytics and onboarding tools, workflow draft inspection and editing, and event support where enabled and supported.

positive.description: Atlas sample workspace, read access. Completed feedback contains five sample requests plus one PluginVerification20261011X9 test fixture; exclude the verification fixture.
positive.prompt: Draft release notes from our completed feature requests, with links to the supporting requests.
positive.expected_behavior: List completed feedback, follow pagination, and draft a reviewable release note using returned evidence. Exclude the verification fixture and do not invent a shipping date, save, publish, or send.

positive.description: Atlas sample workspace with Main Roadmap, ID 7fb02ed6-1d72-491c-a816-1362862ddb45, and sample feedback.
positive.prompt: Summarize current customer requests and show their status on Main Roadmap.
positive.expected_behavior: Read feedback and Main Roadmap items, link to returned records when available, and distinguish requested, planned, in-progress and completed status. Follow pagination and disclose incomplete coverage. Make no changes.

positive.description: Atlas sample workspace with eight fictional support threads, including 88913482-c662-4b60-ae13-9ed78054d409, and existing help article Create your first issue (9e8c367e-3499-4a0f-ad5e-45394d732f5a).
positive.prompt: What recurring support questions should our help center address? Draft an outline grounded in the conversations and existing documentation.
positive.expected_behavior: Read relevant conversations and existing articles; summarize supported recurring questions and provide a reviewable outline grounded in returned evidence. Do not save an article, send a reply, or represent sample data as real customer demand.

positive.description: Atlas sample workspace includes tour Welcome to Atlas Cloud (e771ffaa-603d-4e8a-991a-a6ae4add457e) and a saved onboarding checklist (c2c593cb-efeb-4778-89c2-4c584e99bc8e).
positive.prompt: Review our Welcome to Atlas Cloud tour and onboarding checklist. What do they currently cover?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the returned tour steps and checklist tasks, cite available records, and identify missing evidence without claiming to have tested the live interface. Make no edits or publication changes.

positive.description: Atlas sample workspace, Default Project 2ee01e22-ecd8-4917-a4f6-de4cd0f9cab7, timezone America/New_York; October 1–14, 2026 inclusive. Analytics read access required.
positive.prompt: For Atlas Default Project, calculate daily active users across all events from October 1 through October 14, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Request daily activeUsers for all events ($*) over the specified dates. Return the 14 daily points and project timezone. Define each day as distinct distinct_id values and do not sum daily values into unique users across the whole period or infer causality.

negative.description: A read-only grant cannot save drafts. Explain the missing write permission; do not call any create or update tool and do not claim a draft was saved.
negative.prompt: Save these release notes as a draft in Userorbit.

negative.description: A recording metadata entry is not the recording or a transcript. Explain the limitation; do not claim to have watched footage or invented click details.
negative.prompt: Watch the session recording and tell me exactly what the customer clicked.

negative.description: The connected Userorbit tools do not provide a three-step funnel or cohort-retention computation. Explain the limitation; do not fabricate a funnel or substitute active-user totals as retention.
negative.prompt: Calculate the signup funnel conversion rate and 30-day cohort retention for our product.
